notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
FSR 3.1

- Added support for FSR 3.1, which can be activated in the graphics settings menu. FSR Frame Generation is available as well.

Balance

- Certain telegram types are now less likely to appear, based on the selected difficulty.
- Adjusted enemy AI.

Quality of life

- Changed mouse dragging from Left to Right click.
- Updated the tile menu so that the airplane sub-menus are easier to use.
- Tutorial is now playable from the main menu, instead of only being available when starting a new game.
- Added an icon that appears when combat occurs over a tile.

Other

- Fixed intelligence type telegrams sometimes displaying the allow/deny buttons.
- Performance improvements, mainly to how turns are handled.
- Updated engine version.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Quality of life

- The "Close info panel" keybind (DEFAULT: Tab) has been renamed to "Drop Selection", and can now also be used to de-select squadron markers.

- Added an option for lingering movement arrows in Settings -> Audio & Gameplay. 
With this option enabled, the arrows that indicate marker movement will fade out when the next turn happens, instead of immediately. This option is disabled by default.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015223/a4e86397156a5c84fdf4d780a81ee79cd3fbe3ff.gif


Other

- Adjusted map overlays.
- Fixed airfields sometimes having more planes assigned to them than their upgrade level allows.
- Fixed intelligence type telegrams sometimes displaying the allow/deny buttons.
- Minor performance improvements.
- Updated engine version to UE5.4.1.
